instruction: Repair {{entry}}. Read UTF-8 NDJSON; blank lines are ignored. A valid row is a closed object with service (a nonempty string) and latency (a nonnegative finite JSON number, not a boolean). Invalid JSON and invalid rows each increment invalid. Emit one JSON line {invalid:N, services:[{service,count,total,max},...]}, sorted by service, aggregating only valid rows. Ignore no invalid nonblank line and do not stop at the first error. Inputs have finite aggregate totals. No external packages.
